## Verification / 验证
- [ ] `bash design-tools/check-all.sh` / 已运行源码回归检查
- [ ] `bash build.sh` (only with legally obtained build assets / 仅在已取得合法构建输入时)
- [ ] ARM64 device test for UI / permissions / OEM behavior (if relevant / 相关时)
- [ ] Documentation links and **both languages** checked where applicable / 相关文档中英文及链接已核对

> Static checks and a successful build are **not** real-device acceptance.
> 静态检查和构建成功**不等于**实机验收；未测试的项目请如实说明。

## Privacy and licensing / 隐私与许可
- [ ] No private recordings, API keys, keystores, model weights, MiSans, SDK binaries or APKs in commits / 提交不含上述私密或第三方二进制资产
- [ ] Third-party code/assets keep original attribution and licenses / 第三方代码和资产保留原许可与署名
- [ ] No claim that MIT or user consent grants model redistribution rights / 未将 MIT 或用户确认误写为模型再分发许可
